name: onelo-tools

plugins.name: onelo-auth
plugins.description: Wires Onelo Auth (hosted sign-in/sign-up) into your app. Snippets are fetched live from the Onelo API, so they can never go stale. Staging channel — auto-updates on every commit.

plugins.name: onelo-features
plugins.description: Scans your codebase and inserts onelo-features SDK calls automatically. Staging channel — auto-updates on every commit (cache key = git SHA).

plugins.name: onelo-monitor
plugins.description: Audits and instruments Onelo Monitor SDK usage (Swift, Python). Staging channel — auto-updates on every commit (cache key = git SHA).

description: Onelo developer tooling for Claude Code — auth, store, waitlist, customer portal, feature flags, feedback, roadmap, monitoring and branding. Install the onelo bundle to get everything at once.
